title: Forensic
desc: When a psychotic murderer sets out on a killing spree, Samuel, a medico-legal advisor, uses his forensic skills to unravel the truth behind the heinous deeds.

title: Sheshnaag
desc: Pritam and Banu, two shape-shifting snakes in human form, seek protection from a young man when an evil priest tries to hunt them down and use them in a ritual for wealth and immortality.

title: Army
desc: Arjun, a military officer, is killed by Naagraj, a gangster, during an undercover mission. Devastated by this tragedy, Arjun's pregnant wife Geeta decides to get revenge against Naagraj.
When mobiles start flying from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and his robot Nila are asked to help. However, due to Pakshi Rajan having a hand in this, the two have to reinstate Chitti to defeat him.

title: Bruce Lee
desc: Bruce Lee and his friends get into a fight with the close aides of Ramdoss, an evil don. When the gangster kidnaps Lee's girlfriend, he plans to rescue her.
